newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cable maker Perennial seen in HK$70mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: Cable maker Perennial seen in HK$70mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Electrical cable manufacturer Perennial International Ltd is expected to raise HK$60 million to HK$70 million in its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong later this month, market sources said on Wednesday.
Sources said Perennial is expected to hold a listing presentation for analysts on Monday and the IPO is expected to be launched later in December.
Nikko Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said.
No further listing details were available, sources said.
